posts.title: Welcoming the Hansen family to Jungle Cooking day
posts.excerpt: A Dutch family of five joined our Lunch in the Jungle trip and helped check the fish traps at sunrise.
posts.body:
This month we hosted the Hansen family from the Netherlands for a full morning of Jungle Cooking.

We started at the riverside checking the fish traps that our team sets the night before — the kids were the first ones in the water, cheering every time a trap came up full.

## What we cooked

Using the fish, river shrimp, and vegetables picked along the trail, we cooked lunch together over a wood-fired stove, the same way it's done in every kitchen in the village.

If you'd like a similar morning with your family, message us on WhatsApp and we'll find a date that works.

posts.title: New: Dinner with Locals, now with a picnic beer option
posts.excerpt: We've added a relaxed picnic-style version of our classic Dinner with Locals evening.
posts.body:
By popular request, we now offer a picnic-style version of our Dinner with Locals evening, with local beer included for guests who'd like to end the day with a cold Bintang by the rice fields.

Pricing depends on group size — message us on WhatsApp for a quote for your dates.
